items.title: Heavenly Mother: The Mormon Goddess Nobody Can Pray To?
items.summary: A Mormon News Roundup YouTube video about the LDS doctrine of Heavenly Mother and its history, including why Latter-day Saints are not taught to pray to her.

items.title: Wife of child-molesting ex-Mormon figure once based in Chicago area calls him 'caring,' 'a wonderful father'
items.summary: The Chicago Sun-Times reports that Rebecca Christofferson, wife of Wade Christofferson, described him as "caring" in a letter to a federal judge ahead of his sentencing in an Ohio child sexual abuse case. The paper notes that his brother, apostle D. Todd Christofferson, has faced criticism over when he said he learned of the allegations.

items.title: LDS Church instructs children on how to stop and report unwanted touching
items.summary: The Salt Lake Tribune reports that the church's Friend magazine published "body safety" guidance for children on social media. A Bountiful counselor who treats child sexual abuse survivors tells the paper the information is basic but effective.
